amendments.because: Owner asked for a Neon review test on this Terra-reviewed branch (26 Nov)
amendments.done_when: A review whose findings name files by an absolute path inside the checkout is kept, and those findings show the repo-relative path with no second review run.

done_when: A review whose findings name files by an absolute path inside the checkout is kept, and those findings show the repo-relative path with no second review run. (Trial only: forge.toml sets reviews = "antigravity" for one review and is restored before merge.)

known.title: Not done: A review whose findings name files by an absolute path inside the checkout is kept, and those findings show the repo-relative path

why: A review finding that names a file by its absolute path makes the review helper discard the whole review, so its tokens (about 3M once) are wasted and the review runs again.
